summary: Run-owned asks and updates withdraw when their owning episode ends. Unowned decisions remain independent; authentic answers and source history are retained.

replay.detail: Legacy asks derive ownership from the selected requester declaration at their canonical asking cut. Informational updates about terminal work leave attention without synthetic answers. The person-attention projection rebuilds its episode dependency edges.

compatibility.detail: Supersedes independent-person-asks: new run-owned asks and updates capture the requester's owner run and generation. Ending or superseding that episode withdraws its unresolved attention. Explicit null ownership remains unowned. Cancellation no longer posts a replacement informational card; the requester still receives its cancellation message.

downtime.detail: No downtime beyond the ordinary daemon restart.

recovery.detail: Withdrawal history and authentic responses retain their existing read commands.
